ax.set_xticklabels(weeks)

        color = "white" if val > 20 else "black" # Adjust threshold based on max value
        # Max value is likely around 40+ per week total, spread over 4 reactors -> ~10-15 per cell max?
        # Preview says weekly runs 37-42. 4 reactors. So average ~10.
        # If a reactor has no runs in a week, it's 0.
        
        # Determine text color for readability
        # Normalize colormap limit

        mid = (vmin + vmax) / 2
        if val > mid:

        else:
